adjudication_rule: Each remaining EXPLICIT_IN_BODY occurrence was reviewed source-locally. An explicit source formula is not Core-closed when a load-bearing operation, identification convention, predicate, arithmetic evaluation, or scope relation remains unlowered. No external mathematical definition and no L/cross-track evidence is admitted.

rows.exact_missing_lower_behavior: The source gives an action formula, but multiplication/juxtaposition in g_L x g_R^{-1} is not separately represented; only the inverse exponent is exposed. Exact primitive support for the action evaluation remains missing.

The source notation identifies SU(2) with Sp(1), but the frozen body does not lower whether this is literal object identity, presentation equality, or an isomorphism convention. Collapsing it to primitive equality would overstate the source-local support.

The carrier identification still depends on the named Hom construction, which is explicitly external-definition-required, and the source does not lower the M(2,C) carrier construction. Exact primitive support for the identification is incomplete.

The source states a spinor-weight identification S_L=C^2_0, but the weight/carrier notation C^2_0 is not lowered into primitive structure. Treating the whole occurrence as raw equality would hide load-bearing representation/weight semantics.

The source states S_R=C_-1 + C_+1. Although the plus operation is separately exposed, the weighted carrier terms and the identification/decomposition semantics are not lowered sufficiently for exact primitive closure.
The quotient-carrier equality L^perp=C4/L still hides the quotient construction C4/L; no separate exact lower quotient semantics are represented in this body.

The null-locus equation Phi(s,s)=0 still hides application/evaluation of Phi to (s,s). No separate occurrence supplies that function/application semantics, so the equation cannot close as equality over primitive terms.
The H^1 construction is explicitly name-only/external-definition-required. The equality to C2 therefore cannot be primitive-complete under current W-only authority.

The tangent-bundle identification depends on Hom(S,S^perp), whose Hom constructor is explicitly external-definition-required. The source also does not lower tangent-bundle semantics to primitive support.

The Weyl equation still depends on an external-definition-required dot operation, partial subtraction, and unexposed application/juxtaposition by psi_R. Exact primitive equation support is incomplete.
